captions.detailed: An industrial-grade floor air pump featuring a tall, dark blue cylinder body, a black padded T-handle on a silver metallic piston rod, and a sturdy black base. A circular analog pressure gauge with a white face and a red indicator needle is mounted to the side of the cylinder, featuring a small red pressure-release button below the dial. The T-handle and its piston rod slide vertically into the cylinder, the lower stabilizer bar slides horizontally across the base, and the red release button can be pressed inward.
captions.instruction: Create an industrial floor air pump with a dark blue main cylinder, a black T-handle on a silver piston rod, a side-mounted pressure gauge with a red needle, a red release button, and a sliding stabilizer bar at the base. Ensure the T-handle, release button, and stabilizer bar are modeled as separate parts with prismatic joints for realistic movement.
captions.factory: Construct the main pump frame using a vertical Cylinder for the blue body, a Cylinder for the neck, and a Box for the base. Build the plunger assembly using a horizontal Cylinder for the padded handle and a vertical Cylinder for the metallic piston rod, connected via a prismatic joint. Model the gauge housing with a horizontal cylinder, a thin white cylinder for the dial face, and a thin red box for the needle. Add a small red cylinder for the release button with a prismatic joint, and a horizontal stabilizer bar using nested boxes that slide prismatically relative to the base.
